pre-fix-yarn.meaning: "from sunup till 2 p.m. each day" preserves the earlier partial opening, distinct from the September all-day opening; the temperatures, warnings and handling guidance all survive.
pre-fix-yarn.sense: "knock fish off" correctly means kill here, and "Don't play hooked trout till they're stuffed" preserves the angling sense of play and the exhaustion warning.
pre-fix-yarn.authenticity: "quick smart" and "come good" fit ordinary Australian usage, but the accumulated "yer", "ya" and dropped endings make the presentation slightly performed.
pre-fix-yarn.register: "Anglers'll be right" and "Pitchin' in like this'll" sustain the strong conversational register asked for, within the vulgarity allowance.
pre-fix-yarn.tone: "Handle fish gently and keep 'em in the water" maintains the serious conservation advice beneath the relaxed voice.
pre-fix-yarn.flow: "These rivers were shut to fishin' altogether from July 15, then that got wound back" carries the chronology smoothly despite the dense opening list.
pre-fix-yarn.variety: "wound back", "keep an eye on", "quick smart", "stuffed" and "come good" give varied phrasing without an intrusive repeated catchphrase.
pre-fix-yarn.essence: "Update: Yellowstone lifts full closures on Firehole, Madison and Gibbon rivers" retains the layered update format, operational notice and fish-protection purpose.

current.meaning: "the remaining fishing restrictions" and "Partial restrictions stay in place from 2 p.m. to sunrise the next day" retain the two dated stages accurately, including locations and conditions.
current.sense: "Don't wear hooked trout out by playing them to exhaustion" correctly disambiguates the angling term and preserves the warning.
current.authenticity: "Doing your bit" and "cos water flows were low" are natural informal Australian phrasing with no forced slang.
current.register: "Anglers will be able to fish these rivers" and "temporary restrictions may be lifted" remain essentially neutral notice prose; the very light colloquial touch misses level 5.
current.tone: "Handle fish gently" and "It may also avoid the need to ban fishing" keep the original's cooperative, protective intent.
current.flow: "depending on how conditions shape up when assessed" has an awkward redundant ending, repeated later; the rest reads smoothly.
current.variety: "Doing your bit", "stay in place" and "cooling down" vary the wording without relying on stock tags.
current.essence: "as set out in the 2026 Fishing Regulations booklet" and both updates preserve the regulatory purpose and practical character.

dinkum-3.meaning: "Part-day restrictions still on from 2 p.m. to sunup the next day" and "over 68 degrees Fahrenheit (20 degrees Celsius)" retain the timing, threshold and fish-safety rationale alongside the full notice.
dinkum-3.sense: "Don't play a hooked trout till it's knackered" preserves the technical sense of playing a fish and its exhaustion; "come good" fits recovery.
dinkum-3.authenticity: "Good news for fishos" and "Do us a favour" create a credible Australian oral voice, with a slight performed edge from pervasive "ya" and "yer" spellings.
dinkum-3.register: "fishos can have a go" and "save 'em havin' to ban fishin'" make a sustained strong vernacular retelling within the allowed vulgarity.
dinkum-3.tone: "If everyone does the right thing, it'll look after the park's fisheries" preserves the cooperative conservation appeal rather than making light of fish deaths.
dinkum-3.flow: "Staff'll keep an eye on the water temperatures, mind" is an easy spoken pivot, and the chronological updates remain clear aloud.
dinkum-3.variety: "fishos", "wound back", "mind", "knackered" and "come good" provide a varied vocabulary while the necessary repeated restrictions stay recognisable.
dinkum-3.essence: "like it says in the 2026 Fishing Regulations booklet" keeps the regulatory anchor and the two-stage update structure remains unmistakable.

pre-fix-yarn.why: The extensive phonetic spellings, represented by ya alongside yer and many dropped endings, give otherwise idiomatic speech a slightly performed surface.

current.quote: Anglers will be able to fish these rivers
current.original: Anglers will be able to fish these rivers
current.why: The largely unchanged formal register is far lighter than the full pub yarn requested.

current.quote: how conditions shape up when assessed
current.why: Shape up when assessed is an awkward combination, and it recurs in the second monitoring notice.

dinkum-3.why: Persistent phonetic spellings make the otherwise plausible spoken voice slightly self-conscious on the page.

summaries.pre-fix-yarn: Complete and clear conservation advice in a convincing full-yarn register, with slightly conspicuous eye dialect.
summaries.current: Faithful and appropriately careful, but far too restrained for level 5 and occasionally awkward in the monitoring language.
summaries.dinkum-3: A clear and faithful full yarn that preserves practical urgency and cooperation; comparable overall to A.
